studio.name: Sol Four
studio.intro: Four browser games, each with its own style, under one studio. All of them are set on Mars, and all of them play in the browser.
studio.about: Sol Four is Andreas's studio for browser games on Mars. He builds them as a solo developer. The four games share a home and a mark; each one keeps its own look.

games.name: Areoid
games.pitch: Seal a region of Mars, grow the bloom inside, and open the sky.
games.controls: Drag and pinch the globe; tap a region to work it. Pause, or run time at 1×, 2× or 3×.

games.name: Red Dust Prospectors
games.pitch: Claim ore fields from your Hab, fly the haul home, and defend the network.
games.controls: Drag to move, or use WASD or the arrow keys. The hero attacks on its own. Build from the bar at the bottom.

games.name: Dust & Domes
games.pitch: Lay roads, watch every ware carried by hand, and grow a chain of domes.
games.controls: Drag to pan, pinch or scroll to zoom. Tap the ground to build, tap a flag to lay a road.

games.name: Tharsis
games.pitch: Pick a site on the globe and drive, walk or fly across real Mars.
games.controls: WASD or arrows to drive or walk, mouse to look. On a phone, a stick on the left and drag to look.
games.session: Open-ended; you go as far as you like.
